articles.title: Lauren Boebert Defeated by Blue Wave as Democrat Cruises to Victory
articles.dek: Colorado MAGA Representative Lauren Boebert has been washed away in the blue wave, losing her election to Democrat Eileen Laubacher in a stunning upset that is one of many GOP midterm failures.
